## Description

Brief description of changes and why they are needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New experience
- [ ] Enhancement
- [ ] Docs / DX

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The requested behavior is implemented without unrelated changes.
- [ ] Regression tests cover changed behavior where applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] Typecheck passes (`corepack pnpm typecheck`)
- [ ] Lint passes (`corepack pnpm lint`)
- [ ] Formatting check passes (`corepack pnpm format:check`)
- [ ] Unit tests pass (`corepack pnpm test`)
- [ ] E2E tests pass when UI/flows change (`corepack pnpm test:e2e`)
- [ ] Production build passes (`corepack pnpm build`)
- [ ] Added metadata and registry entry for a new experience (if applicable)
- [ ] Tested on mobile and respects `prefers-reduced-motion` (if UI changes)
